fieldNotes.truckGate: Engineered multi-lane controlled entry at the head of the private north boulevard (~42.7121, -87.8860); white directional lane arrows split inbound/outbound around a central guard building.
fieldNotes.guardShack: Substantial central guardhouse with hipped roof, ~3-4 vehicle footprint, set in the median of the entry boulevard with traffic lanes routed around both sides. Larger than a typical booth but functions as the manned gate house.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide gate apron with multiple paved lanes and a deep boulevard approach; ample paved width to add an express/bypass lane.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Private boulevard from public road to gate and on to the docks is several hundred metres; easily holds 3+ trucks queued.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Multiple large trailer-storage lots in the north and mid-west of the campus, rows of nose-out parked trailers (white/blue/orange fleet) plus dock-adjacent banks; 50+ easily.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: 2.2M sq ft, 15 production lines; multiple dock banks visible on separate building faces (NW bank and S/SE bank). Door count is an overhead-imagery estimate, banded 50+.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Distinct dock banks on different building faces (north-west building face vs south/south-east face) consistent with separated shipping and receiving.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Campus of ~9 distinct large buildings (manufacturing halls, warehouse, components plant, tank farm/dome) on one fenced property.
fieldNotes.railServed: Active rail spur curves into the property from the south-west with multiple sidings holding boxcars / covered hoppers.
fieldNotes.scale: No truck scale positively identified in the gate path; left false but listed uncertain — a scale could exist within the unmapped interior.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Edge-of-town industrial setting in Mt. Pleasant; large natural buffer (woods/wetland) on the west and open land around; broader setting judged Rural per rubric.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: Perimeter box ~1.22 km N-S x 0.78 km E-W of fenced developed property; ~218 acres is an estimate of the active fenced footprint (SC Johnson land holding here is larger).
